name: Adelaide Zoo
tagline: Adelaide Zoo — compact city zoo; giant pandas when viewing is open.

practical.ticket_note: City zoo; giant panda talks ~1:15pm — confirm adelaidezoo.com.au. Large African species mostly at Monarto Safari Park (separate ticket/site).
practical.transit_note: From Adelaide CBD / North Terrace area.
practical.best_start: Pandas if open, else one calm circuit.
